scope: Native rendered-frame intervals including capture overhead; focused and unpaused subset is reported separately. No hardware portability claim.
measurementDetails: No forced GC: managed memory uses GC.GetTotalMemory(false). Profiler counters are the latest completed samples at observation time and may lag the reported rendered interval; unavailable values are -1. Current simulationMs covers the observed AdvanceFrame call, simulationSteps records actual steps since the previous observation. lastTickNavigationMs covers only the last World.Tick, not all catch-up steps. WorldView timing includes its presentation work, not render-thread/GPU time. Camera-relevant animation includes a 15% viewport border and selected units. CollectionCount deltas are not allocation bytes or proof of a leak.
